notes.too few letter pixels to check: Text the sweep could not find enough letter pixels in to measure. Decision 0012 counts that as a failure, not a skip: almost always the letters sit too close to what is behind them (faint text, or text over page art). Only zero size, off-screen, clipped, hidden or aria-hidden decorative text is left out, and decorative emoji are not text. J to confirm each when fixing the look.
notes.no visible focus ring: Focusing the control changed nothing visible around it or its label (WCAG 2.4.7).
notes.focus ring (N): The ring is visible but contrasts N:1 with what is behind it; 3:1 is needed (WCAG 1.4.11).
